morph: abl + adv + abl + opt + n.acc.sg, fused 5-way

options.grounds: after the aforesaid śaktipāta one should perform the funerary initiation
of followers of the upper teaching
of him who stumbled through negligence
making that — last first, first last (reverse order)
having withdrawn, each oblation which (twofold rite)
in him whose samaya is bathed in worship-meditation-mantra
may become — dear lady (the Goddess addressed)
on the head of the pure-minded (for him; flagged lightly)

morph: gen.pl + adv + nom.sg + inst.sg + inst.sg, fused 5-way

options.grounds: for them here by the ultra-compassionate guru

morph: opt + adj, fused (loc sense via vidhau)

options.grounds: from the foot to the head-end
with what lies inside suṣumnā indeed
for this purpose this is taught
as giving what serves liberation (signs don't cause it — lore)
through proofs — since beyond the senses
the puryaṣṭaka-class offering is taught here
on the ear-petal lotus (ritual diagram; flagged)
should offer to Brahmā and the rest in order
thus told is this funerary sacrifice
